props.title: Use ShowAI in your agent
props.lead: When your agent and ShowAI run on the same computer, install the plugin for that host. For ChatGPT web, Grok Bot or another client, you can install the universal plugin first and connect ShowAI in the host.

values.package: Six Skills, the MCP launch configuration and host-specific display instructions.
values.setup: Enable it in the local host to connect its registered ShowAI runtime and library.

values.package: Six Skills and an offline connection guide.
values.setup: Add MCP in the host or reuse an existing connection. Hosts that support MCP Apps can render interactive views in chat.

content.text: Install and open ShowAI on the same computer as the agent. Select the library, then install one host plugin. All five packages include their MCP launch configuration. Settings → MCP shows the runtime, provides the launch configuration and lists calls with their client and tool.

steps.title: Codex · Claude Code · Antigravity
steps.body: In ShowAI Settings → Plugins, find your host and choose Install plugin. Its command-line tool must be available first.

steps.title: DeepSeek Harness
steps.body: Open DeepSeek Harness once, then quit it completely. In ShowAI, go to Settings → Agent plugins, find DeepSeek Harness and choose Install plugin. ShowAI installs the six Skills and local MCP connection, and verifies that the bundle is enabled. Reopen Harness to use it.

steps.title: Kimi Work
steps.body: Register the [Kimi Work plugin](https://github.com/Renaissance-Mind/ShowAI/tree/main/plugins-kimi/showai) in the local plugin manager, then install and enable it under Plugins → Personal → ShowAI. Its bundled MCP launcher defaults to ~/.showai. For a different registered library, set SHOWAI_HOME in this configuration.

Export the ZIP from desktop Settings → Plugins → Export universal plugin, or download it from this page. Import it in a compatible plugin host, or load its six Skill directories in an Agent Skills client. Then add MCP in that host.
covers ChatGPT, Grok Bot over public or private networks, same-device agents and other clients.
Try a preview, then save it

First ask “Use ShowAI to draw the approval branches for a leave request, just in chat.” This uses show-visual and needs no new project. Then ask “Save that chart to our team project.” The agent confirms the project, checks the save receipt and returns the original page.

Local host plugins use the selected ShowAI library. The universal plugin uses the server configured in the host and the projects granted to that connection. When ChatGPT connects to your desktop app over the internet, the page is still saved in the ShowAI library on that computer.
Give the agent the project, page or selection. It reads the original and its version before saving changes. If another edit intervenes, compare the versions and return to the same page after saving.

steps.title: Install plugin
steps.body: The Codex installer needs the Codex CLI on your `PATH`. It installs through the official Codex plugin commands and verifies the version, enabled state and file fingerprints.
